# AWS Encryption SDK message reference

Generated by tools/reference/generate-datamasking-kms.mjs from the actual Powertools TypeScript v2.35.0 provider and @aws-crypto/client-node v5.0.2. The 39 encrypted-message cases include 36 provider round trips and three direct SDK byte payloads to verify TextDecoder behavior. Each ordinary case also records five expected-context outcomes. Five malformed/tampered messages must be rejected; exact cross-SDK exception wording is not normalized into an equivalence claim.

The local KMS fixture wrapping blobs contain plaintext test material. These artifacts are not confidential and must never protect production data. Real AWS Encryption SDK encryption/signatures/authenticated message framing are exercised, but the fixture does not implement secure KMS wrapping or AWS authorization.

Run the generator without flags only when intentionally refreshing randomized TypeScript ciphertexts. The --verify-go option consumes the existing corpus and a locally cross-compiled Linux Go bridge, then writes docs/DATAMASKING_KMS_INTEROP.json without changing the fixture. The Windows host executes that bridge in Docker.
